  <h3>LimiX-2: A Contextual Mechanism Network Towards General Structured-Data Intelligence</h3>
  <p>LimiX-2 uses Contextual Mechanism Networks and context-conditional masked modeling to learn the joint structure of tabular data from synthetic causal datasets. It improves prediction across three tabular benchmarks and its feature attention supports causal skeleton recovery.</p>
